span.div:
10 instances × 500 SLOs × 1KB per SLO = 5 MB per instance
1,000 flushes/sec per instance = 50 MB/s per instance
Output: 500 merged window entries per minute to Kafka

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
100 instances × 50 KB/s = 5 MB/s total metric events
Each instance: 10K event buffer, 10s flush interval
Memory per instance: 10K × 50 bytes = 500 KB

span.div:
Time-Series DB: 500 entries/min × 200 bytes = 100 KB/min
30-day retention: 4.3 GB
Object Store: 90-day archive: 12.9 GB

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
1 topic, 10 partitions, replication factor 3
500 entries/min = 8.3 entries/sec = negligible load
Retention: 7 days, then archival to object store

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.div:
3 evaluators × 167 SLOs × 1 MB = 167 MB each
500 evaluations/min = trivial CPU
Snapshot every hour: 500 MB to object store

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Total infrastructure: 10 aggregator instances + 3 evaluator instances
+ 3 Kafka brokers + 1 TSDB cluster = 17 nodes for full SLO pipeline
